lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Nobody tells you ChatGPT can invent a source.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Studies, quotes, links. All very confident.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: But it gave me a link!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Click it. Sometimes it goes nowhere.

lines.speaker: NOVA
directions: on screen: link opens to a 404 page

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: No. It predicts what a source should look like.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That's literally lying with extra steps.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Fair. Fix: turn on web search, then click every link.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: If you can't open it, you can't quote it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: So the source doesn't exist until I click it.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Comment SOURCES for my 3-step check. Click every source.
